what_the_move_did_not_buy.arithmetic: DLH0010A WSON-10, 0.400 mm pitch, 0.750 x 0.200 mm lands => 0.200 mm land-to-land gap and 0.600 mm between the lands either side of an inner pin.  A 0.200 mm track at the board's 0.200 mm routed clearance needs EXACTLY 0.600 mm: it fits with ZERO margin and no rasterised lattice can express zero (Field's guard band is 0.75 of a cell).  A 0.150 mm track needs 0.550 mm and has 0.050 mm of real margin.
what_the_move_did_not_buy.consequence: the refusal is a property of the LAND PATTERN.  It does not move with the part, it does not move with the layer count (D-705) and it does not move with the board area (D-705 section 5).
what_the_move_did_not_buy.verdict: THREE OF U11's TEN PINS STILL CANNOT LAUNCH IN THE MIDDLE OF AN EMPTY 5 x 5 mm POCKET
